source.snippet: I'm looking for a browser-based SaaS tool for securely sharing documents with investors, clients and external stakeholders. Required features: Support for PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, images and video. Email verification, password protection and NDA acceptance. Download controls, link expiration and dynamic watermarking. Page-by-page viewing analytics and time spent. Returning-visitor and engagement tracking. Multi-document data rooms or branded microsites. Analytics export. Custom branding, custom domains.

problem_statement: Sales and business development teams need a secure document-sharing tool with granular per-page engagement analytics, NDA gating, dynamic watermarking, and branded data rooms — existing options either lack analytics depth or are priced for enterprise only.
target_segment: Sales reps, founders, and BD professionals at SMBs sharing proposals, decks, and due-diligence documents with investors or clients
notes: Buyer is explicit: they enumerate a detailed feature list typical of someone who has already evaluated competitors (Docsend, Pitch, Notion) and found gaps. Business context is clear — sharing with investors and external stakeholders. Willingness to pay implied by framing as a SaaS tool search with enterprise-grade requirements. Strong signal despite being a single post because the specificity of requirements indicates active vendor evaluation.
